|colspan="6" align="left" style="width:50px;"| '''Notes:'''<br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|ambassador|1}} As the two ambassadors for the merged tribe, Bertrand and Jean-Bernard had to cast an extra vote for someone at the first post-merge Tribal Council. Because they could not come to a decision, they drew rocks. Bertrand drew the rock, but won immunity, nullifying the extra vote.<br />
{{note|medical|2}} Due to medical reasons requiring them to return to France, Christopher and Hakim were not a part of the final jury.<br />
{{note|final4|3}} At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Nathalie came in last and was eliminated.
{{refend}}
